def solve():
    n, m, s, t = map(int, input().split())
    s -= 1
    t = int(t)

    while t % n != 0:
        curJump = t % n
        sign = 1 if s < m else -1
        s += sign * curJump
        s %= n
        t -= 1

    lastSeem = [-1] * n
    while t != 0:
        for _ in range(n):
            curJump = t % n
            sign = 1 if s < m else -1
            s += sign * curJump
            s %= n
            t -= 1
        if lastSeem[s] != -1:
            interval = lastSeem[s] - t
            t %= interval
            break
        else:
            lastSeem[s] = t

    while t != 0:
        curJump = t % n
        sign = 1 if s < m else -1
        s += sign * curJump
        s %= n
        t -= 1

    print(s + 1)
